mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte derangements (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that may be exacerbated by niacin's vasodilatory effects and metabolic stress on renal function.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation during concurrent use.
